rules: Use reported billable units, not net invoice amounts or planning reservations.
Bundled ephemeral storage is part of the service tariff, not an account monthly free tier.
AgentCore deployment revision 10 is not pricing generation v2; the observed billing SKU uses v1 rates.
Aliyun FC and Session MCP share the same CU tariff; protocol calls and retained sessions must be attributed.
Mixed metering buckets remain intervals, never proportional per-request allocations.
Missing storage, logging, network, registry or control usage remains unknown, not zero.
